questions.question: Which organ pumps blood all around the body?
questions.funFact: Your heart beats about 100,000 times every single day without ever taking a rest.

questions.question: Which organs help us breathe in air?
questions.funFact: We have two lungs, and the right one is a little bigger than the left.

questions.question: Which organ controls the whole body and helps us think?
questions.funFact: Your brain keeps working even while you are fast asleep.

questions.question: An adult human body has 206 bones.
questions.funFact: More than half of all your bones are found in your hands and feet.

questions.question: The largest organ of the human body is the ___.
questions.funFact: Your skin protects everything inside your body, like a stretchy waterproof coat.

questions.question: How many milk teeth does a young child usually have?
questions.funFact: Children have 20 milk teeth, which slowly fall out and are replaced by 32 adult teeth.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT a sense organ?
questions.funFact: Our five sense organs are the eyes, ears, nose, tongue and skin.

questions.question: The stomach helps to digest the food we eat.
questions.funFact: The stomach mixes food with special juices to break it down into tiny bits.

questions.question: We use our ___ to see the world around us.
questions.funFact: Blinking helps keep your eyes clean and wet, and you blink thousands of times a day.

questions.question: Which organs clean our blood and make urine?
questions.funFact: We have two kidneys, each shaped like a bean, that filter our blood many times a day.

questions.question: Match each body part to the job it does.
questions.funFact: All the organs of the body work together as a team to keep us alive and healthy.

questions.question: Babies are born with more bones than grown-ups.
questions.funFact: Babies are born with around 300 bones, and many of them join together as the baby grows up.
